Package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso

package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso
OAuth/IDCS authentication flows (authorization code, device code, JWT assertion) for connecting to EPM Cloud environments that require single sign-on rather than native username/password credentials. These are constructed directly by callers who need SSO; there is no factory wiring for them today.
